institution: 西安电子科技大学广州研究院
architecture: Training-free geometric template matcher: 6 sub-window x 5-band FFT filter bank, channel correlation logSPD (855-d), per-task z-score, PCA-256, within-class whitening (shrink 0.95) + cosine match against 4 trial-order prototypes per identity; the unregistered decision is an explicit match-score gate s1 + 0.5*(s1-s2) < tau, with tau lowered by 0.06 only for winners 21-23
description: Each 4 s trial is cut into six 200-sample sub-windows; each sub-window is split into five frequency bands, the 18x18 channel correlation of each band is shrunk and mapped to the log-SPD tangent space, z-scored per band, and the six 855-d vectors are averaged. Task-wise standardisation and PCA (256-d) are fitted on Train session1 only. Each identity is registered as four trial-order prototypes, matched by within-class-whitened cosine (shrink 0.95). The open-set gate combines the absolute best match with its margin over the runner-up; tau = 0.40756 is the 10% quantile of cross-fitted Train genuine late scores (90% Train acceptance). Identities 1-20 use all Train trials; new users 21-23 receive four prototypes each from the provided enrollment samples and enroll never changes the pretrained statistics.
